local utils = require( 'Module:SkillUtils' ) local trees = mw.loadData('Module:SkillUtils/TreeData') local hatchets, woodcutting_mult do local _hatchet_data = mw.loadData('Module:SkillUtils/HatchetData') hatchets = _hatchet_data.hatchets woodcutting_mult = _hatchet_data.mult end local geprices = mw.loadJsonData('Module:GEPrices/data.json') local yn = require('Module:Yesno') local pt = require('Module:Paramtest') local round = require("Module:Round").round local lang = mw.getContentLanguage() require("Module:Mw.html extension") local p = {} local function plink(link, image, text) _text = text _image = image if text == nil then _text = link end if image == nil then _image = link end return string.format('[[File:%s.png|link=%s]] [[%s|%s]]', _image, link, link, _text) end local function multifloor(x, m) local _x = x for i,v in ipairs(m) do _x = math.floor( _x * v ) end return _x end local function gep(x) return geprices[x] or 0 end local function fnum(num, dp) local ret = math.pow(10, dp) * num + 0.5 ret = math.floor(ret) ret = math.pow(10, -dp) * ret return lang:formatNum(ret) end function perc(x) return round(x * 100, 1) .. "%" end function p.makeFellTable() local t = mw.html.create('table') t:addClass('wikitable sortable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed align-right-2 align-right-3') :tag('caption'):wikitext('Tree fell chances'):done() :tr() :th('Tree') :th('Fell chance
(x/256)') :th('Percentage') for i,v in ipairs(trees) do if v.fell ~= nil and v.fell ~= -1 then t:tr() :td('[['..v.name..']]') :td(v.fell) :td(perc(v.fell/256)) end end return t end function p.makeSimpleTable() local col2 = {"colspan", 2} local t = mw.html.create('table') :addClass('wikitable sortable sticky-header mw-collapsible mw-collapsed text-align-right align-center-1 align-left-2 align-center-3') :tag('caption'):wikitext('Tree high and low chances'):done() :tr() :th{'Order', attr={'rowspan', 2}} :th{'Tree
Logs', attr={'rowspan', 2}} :th{'Level', attr={'rowspan', 2}} :th{'Base XP', attr={'rowspan', 2}} :th{'Fell chance
(x/256)', attr={'rowspan', 2}} local hatchetrow = t:done() -- grab the parent tr() to the th{}'s above local hlrow = t:tr() for _, hatchet in ipairs(hatchets) do local linkstr = string.format('[[File:%s|link=%s]] [[%s|%s]]', hatchet.image, hatchet.label, hatchet.label, hatchet.label) hatchetrow:th{linkstr, attr=col2} hlrow:th("Low"):th("High") end for i, tree in ipairs(trees) do local namecell = '[['..tree.name..']]' if tree.logs then namecell = namecell..'
'..plink(tree.logs) end local fellchance = tree.fell if fellchance == -1 then fellchance = nil end local tr = t:tr() tr :td(i) :td(namecell) :td(tree.level) :td(tree.xp) :IF(not fellchance):na():ELSE():td(fellchance):END() for _, hatchet in ipairs(hatchets) do local low, high = utils.woodcutting_low_high(tree.chance, hatchet.power, tree.ratio) tr :td(low) :td(high) end end return t:allDone() end function p.calculator(frame) return p._calculator(frame:getParent().args) end local multipliers_list = { skillchompa = { cobalt = 1.01, viridian = 1.02, azure = 1.03, crimson = 1.04, crystal = 1.05 }, aura = { basic = 1.03, greater = 1.05, master = 1.07, supreme = 1.1, legendary = 1.15 }, outfit = { sentinel = 1.05, ["nature's sentinel"] = 1.07, ["nature's sentinel"] = 1.07 }, offhand = 1.06, ring = 1.03, idol = 1.1, menaphos = 1.1, familiar = { ['beaver'] = 2 }, crystallise = { None = 1, Crystallise = 1.2, ["Crystallise and Light Form"] = 1.4 }, offhand_log = 0.2, juju_log = 0.05 } function p._calculator(args) local level = tonumber(args.level) or 99 local spots = {} local spots_order = {} -- setup multipliers local hi_multipliers = {} local lo_multipliers = {} local xp_multipliers = {} local arg_hatchet = string.gsub(string.lower(args.hatchet or ''), '%s', '_') local hatchet = {} local in_hatchets = false for _, hatchet_ in ipairs(hatchets) do if arg_hatchet == hatchet_.short then in_hatchets = true hatchet = hatchet_ end end if not in_hatchets then hatchet = hatchets[1] end -- if table.insert(t, nil) is a noop for _, v in ipairs({ 'skillchompa', 'outfit', 'aura'}) do if pt.has_content(args[v]) then table.insert(hi_multipliers, multipliers_list[v][string.lower(args[v])]) end end for _, v in ipairs({'ring', 'idol', 'offhand'}) do if yn(args[v]) then table.insert(hi_multipliers, multipliers_list[v]) end end -- only applies to menaphos fish local menaphos = {} if yn(args.menaphos) then menaphos = { multipliers_list.menaphos } end -- both hi and low local _h = tonumber(args.honed) or 0 local honed = 0 if hatchet.augmentable and _h > 0 then honed = 1 + 0.02 * _h if yn(args.level20) then honed = 1 + 0.022 * _h end end -- familiar is special local familiar = 0 if pt.has_content(args.familiar) then familiar = multipliers_list.familiar[string.lower(args.familiar)] or 0 end -- multiple log chance local log_multi = 1 if yn(args.offhand) then log_multi = log_multi + multipliers_list.offhand_log end if yn(args.juju) then log_multi = log_multi + multipliers_list.juju_log end -- !!! NEW: Cadantine incense sticks logic !!! -- Gives a 2.5% chance per potency level to not deplete a tree. -- We'll approximate this by giving a flat bonus to logs/hr, -- since you spend less time running between trees. if pt.has_content(args.cadantine) and args.cadantine ~= "None" then local cadantine_pot = tonumber(args.cadantine) or 0 -- 0.025 (2.5%) extra logs simulated per potency level log_multi = log_multi + (0.025 * cadantine_pot) end --[==[ -- undecided if i want to add this, since i then should really add all of the other xp multipliers and there's a lot if (tonumber(args.xpoutfit) or 0) > 0 then if tonumber(args.xpoutfit) >= 4 then table.insert(xp_multipliers, 1.05) else table.insert(xp_multipliers, 1+(0.01*tonumber(args.xpoutfit))) end end --]==] -- filter into spot-groupings of the relevant things based on level for _, v in ipairs(trees) do local addSpot = level >= v.level if addSpot then local spotName = v.name table.insert(spots_order, spotName) spots[spotName] = v end end -- construct output table local ret = mw.html.create('table') :addClass('wikitable sortable text-align-right align-left-1 align-left-2') :tr() :th('Tree') :th('Logs') :th("[[File:Woodcutting-icon.png|link=Woodcutting]] XP") :th('Success chance') :th('Logs/hr') :th('XP/hr') :th('GP/hr') local hatchet_power = hatchet.power if (hatchet.proficiency and level >= hatchet.proficiency.level) then hatchet_power = hatchet_power + hatchet.proficiency.power end for _, v in ipairs(spots_order) do local tree = spots[v] local tr = ret:tr() local delay = 4 local totalGPH = 0 local totalXPH = 0 local low, high = utils.woodcutting_low_high(tree.chance, hatchet_power, tree.ratio) local newHi = multifloor(high, hi_multipliers) if tree.is_menaphos then newHi = multifloor(newHi, menaphos) end local newLo = multifloor(low, lo_multipliers) if honed > 0 then newHi = math.ceil( newHi * honed ) newLo = math.ceil( newLo * honed ) end if familiar > 0 then local fambuff = math.floor( familiar * math.floor( 10 * ( high - low ) / 98 ) / 10 ) newHi = newHi + fambuff newLo = newLo + fambuff end -- caps chance at 100% local chance = math.min(utils.stat_roll(newLo, newHi, level, woodcutting_mult), 1) local lph = 6000 / delay * log_multi * chance totalGPH = lph * gep(tree.ge or tree.logs) local xp = tree.xp if tree.is_bgh_tree then xp = level end if tree.can_crystallise then xp = tree.xp * multipliers_list.crystallise[args.crystallise or 'None'] end -- !!! NEW: Torstol incense sticks logic !!! -- Increases base XP by 0.5% per potency level if pt.has_content(args.torstol) and args.torstol ~= "None" then local torstol_pot = tonumber(args.torstol) or 0 xp = xp * (1 + (0.005 * torstol_pot)) end totalXPH = lph * xp tr:td('[['..tree.name..']]') if tree.logs then tr:td(plink(tree.logs)) else tr:na() end tr :td(round(xp, 1)) :td(perc(chance)) :td(fnum(lph, 0)) :td(round(totalXPH, 0, true)) :td(fnum(totalGPH, 0)) end return ret:allDone() end return p
